1.t: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?

2.t: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

6.t: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

7.t: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.

8.t: In that day other faces will be calm,

11.t: Where they hear no idle speech,

17.t: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

18.t: And the heaven, how it is raised?

19.t: And the hills, how they are set up?

20.t: And the earth, how it is spread?

21.t: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

22.t: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

23.t: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

24.t: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

25.t: Lo! unto Us is their return
